changes.title: Tiger
items: A new creature for the jungle west: the tiger, a long, low, striped cat; its legend is the elder of the tigers, huge and scarred, its ruff gone white, hung with a garland of offerings
Its own area, the Bamboo jungle: dense bamboo groves under tall kapoks and strangler figs, and a heap of mossed temple rubble in the clearing
The tiger's legend, asleep under the ferns, gives Tiger's Pounce: a longer blink, and quicker off the mark

changes.title: Meadow cat
items: The meadow's animal is now the wildcat, a stocky striped tabby that pounces, in place of the glow-worm; its legend is the meadow's old queen, white-whiskered and crowned in gold
The meadow has a few more trees and small copses
The wildcat's legend gives Paw prints: your 💌s leave a trail that lands too

changes.title: Penguin
items: A new animal for the cold island to the north: the penguin, waddling about and belly-sliding at you in a fight, in its own snowy rookery on a rocky shore
Its legend is an ancient penguin god, weathered like sea rock, its chick at its feet; happy, it gives Penguin's Toboggan: quicker on foot
